text:
emma: CS-SAM flagged a customer (Lumos) in apac-realtime — p95 for /v1/embeddings jumped from ~120ms -> ~650ms since ~03:40 UTC, multiple errors 504 reported. they say started after maintenance window
pranay: thx, linking logs + metrics. is this only Lumos or broader?
sre-oncall: alerting shows cluster ap-south-1 node pool latency spike for GPU hosts from 03:35-03:50, p95/p99 moved up. routing shows requests hitting dedicated-gpu-pool-03.
emma: CS provided request id examples: req=5f3a1c, 5f3a2b, 5f3a9d. putting them in trace.
pranay: grabbing packet traces and nvtop output. initial hunch: hostfs I/O queue depth spike causing KV cache stalls -> increased tail latency. happened right after driver+fw deploy at 03:30.
mike: can you paste the deploy tags? which driver/fw?
pranay: driver: nvidia-driver-525.89 -> 526.30 rolled 03:28-03:34. GPU FW pushed via fwctl 1.2.7 -> 1.2.9.
emma: repro on a repro node shows periodic iowait and NVMe latency spikes. sharing snippets.
emma: ```iostat -x 1 5
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz   await  r_await  w_await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1         102.00  150.00 8192.00 12288.00  128.00   12.34   85.67   90.00   82.45   0.50  12.34
```
pranay: and dmesg shows repeated firmware timeouts: ```[  203.123456] nvme nvme0: abort request status: 0x40000 timeout
[  203.124000] nvme nvme0: controller reset failed
```
tina: interesting, CS also reported a couple of auth 401 transient spikes in same window, possibly retries amplifying load.
cs-sam: customer confirms they saw 401s then large latencies, they retried client-side with exponential backoff but still hit p99s.
sre-oncall: quick mitigation options: 1) route Lumos to a different pool (older driver nodes) 2) cordon affected hosts 3) rollback driver/firmware cluster-wide.
mike: we have healthy spare capacity in gpu-pool-02 that still runs driver-525.89 (pre-upgrade). can we route Lumos there while triaging?
emma: yes, I can add a route override for Lumos tenant to gpu-pool-02 for next 60m. doing that now.
ops-bot: DeployGate: routing-change applied -> tenant=lumos -> pool=gpu-pool-02 (expires in 60m) :ok_hand:
emma: post-routing metrics look better for Lumos: p95 back to ~140ms within two min. still seeing host‑level nvme errors on affected nodes.
pranay: assigning a kernel/driver bisect. hypothesis: new driver+fw interacts poorly with our I/O scheduler when KV cache evictions spike. next steps: collect perf, iostat across hosts, nvme SMART, and reproduce with synthetic KV cache heavy load.
tina: also note auth spikes — need to check proxy logs for 401 pattern. could be token expiry propagation with retries.
cs-sam: customer is ok with a warm failover while we investigate. they want ETA for fix/rollback.
sre-oncall: ETA: rollback plan ready -> if repro shows consistent failure we'll rollback driver on pool-03 to 525.89 + fw 1.2.7 tonight 00:30 UTC window. will coordinate with ENG-DRIVER team.
mike: I'll start collecting node list for pool-03 and mark for immediate cordon if errors persist. list: node-03-01, node-03-02, node-03-04, node-03-07.
emma: added tickets: INF-4321 (triage), INF-4322 (route override), INF-4323 (rollback playbook). linking metrics + traces.
pranay: for repro snippet, running a KV-cache heavy workload:```python
# repro script outline
for _ in range(1000):
  send_embed_request(prefix=random_str(32))
  sleep(0.01)
```
pranay: running this against a canary node with driver-526.30 reproduces 3x p95 and nvme avgqu-sz jumps to ~10. driver-525.89 node shows steady p95, no nvme errors.
sre-oncall: that's a strong signal. please preserve logs and collect full `dmesg`, `nvme list`, `smartctl -a` for both nodes.
emma: collected and attached to INF-4321. key SMART attr: increased media and ctrl timeout counts on affected nvme devices.
tina: pinging auth team to sanity-check 401s during the spike — maybe token signer latencies. @pranay can you attach proxy traces?
pranay: attaching proxy logs -> many 401s from the same token pool due to short TTL cache miss during spike. mitigation: increase auth cache TTL to 30s for edge proxies for now.
cs-sam: customer requests confirmation when rollback planned. also asks if billing will be adjusted for degraded SLA window.
sre-oncall: we'll request billing review, tag incident as customer-impact. rollback planned if further repros in next 2 hours.
emma: schedule: 21:00 UTC rollback window ready if needed. assigning ENG-DRIVER to prepare revert packages.
mike: checklist for rollback: 1) cordon pool-03 nodes 2) drain running jobs -> fallback to gpu-pool-02 3) apply driver rollback + fw reflash 4) run smoke tests 5) uncordon
ina: (via DM) recommend we also throttle client retries via gateway to reduce amplification during reconfiguration.
pranay: agreed. setting retry cap to 3 and jitter at gateway for Lumos tenant.
ops-bot: ConfigChange: gateway retry policy updated for tenant=lumos -> max_retries=3 (effective).
emma: monitoring continues. logging incident as P1 until fully resolved. will update INF threads with postmortem once root cause confirmed. :face_with_monocle:
